Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 2026

Primeline Products Philippines, Inc. (“Primeline,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) affirms its commitment to uphold the fundamental right to privacy of its employees. This Privacy Policy establishes the standards and procedures by which Primeline collects, uses, stores, and protects personal data submitted through the HR Service Portal, in strict compliance with the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173), its Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR), and issuances of the National Privacy Commission (NPC). The purpose of this Policy is to ensure that all personal data processed through the HR Service Portal are handled lawfully, fairly, and transparently. It seeks to safeguard employee information against unauthorized access, misuse, loss, alteration, or disclosure, while enabling Primeline to fulfill its legitimate human resource management functions. This Policy applies to all employees of Primeline who submit personal data through the HR Service Portal, as well as to HR personnel, system administrators, and authorized third party service providers who may process such data under our authority. It governs all stages of data processing, including collection, recording, organization, storage, updating, retrieval, consultation, use, sharing, and disposal. Primeline implements organizational, physical, and technical security measures designed to protect personal data from risks of breach, unauthorized access, or unlawful processing. These measures include access controls, encryption, secure storage, audit trails, and regular compliance reviews. Employees are assured that their personal data will not be retained longer than necessary and will be securely disposed of once the purpose of processing has been achieved.

Collection of Information

When you access and utilize the HR Service Portal, We may collect and process personal information necessary for the administration of employment and related services, which may include but is not limited to your full name, employee identification number, job title or position, department or business unit, official contact details (such as email address and telephone number), and any additional information you voluntarily provide when submitting requests, forms, or letters through the system (including but not limited to applications for employment certificates, benefits enrollment, payroll or compensation adjustments, and other HR related documentation). All such personal data are collected for legitimate human resource management purposes, processed in accordance with the principles of transparency, proportionality, and lawful purpose under the Data Privacy Act of 2012, and safeguarded through appropriate organizational, physical, and technical measures to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

How We Use Your Information

All personal data collected through the HR Service Portal are used exclusively for legitimate human resource management purposes, which include but are not limited to the processing of HR related requests, the preparation and issuance of official employment documents, the verification of employment details, the administration of compensation, benefits, and entitlements, and the continuous improvement of HR services delivered through the portal. Primeline expressly affirms that such personal information shall never be sold, rented, or otherwise commercially exploited for the benefit of third parties, and shall only be disclosed to authorized personnel or service providers strictly on a need to know basis in accordance with lawful and contractual obligations. The use of employee data is governed by the principles of transparency, proportionality, and accountability under the Data Privacy Act of 2012, ensuring that all processing activities are limited to their intended HR functions and safeguarded by appropriate organizational, physical, and technical measures to preserve confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

Legal Basis

Primeline’s data processing activities are firmly anchored on the core principles of legitimacy, proportionality, transparency, and accountability as mandated by the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173) and its Implementing Rules and Regulations. Personal data shall be collected and processed only when necessary, appropriate, and directly relevant to lawful human resource purposes, which include but are not limited to recruitment and hiring, employment administration, payroll and compensation management, statutory benefits processing, performance evaluation, compliance with labor and social legislation, and other legitimate business operations essential to the employer employee relationship. All processing activities are undertaken in good faith, with due regard to the rights of employees as data subjects and are strictly limited to what is necessary to achieve the intended HR objectives. Primeline ensures that such activities are carried out in a manner that is lawful, fair, and transparent, supported by organizational, physical, and technical safeguards designed to uphold accountability and protect employee information against unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure.

Data Sharing

Primeline does not, under any circumstances, sell, rent, or commercially exploit personal information of its employees. Any data collected through the HR Service Portal shall be shared strictly on a controlled and limited basis, internally only with duly authorized HR personnel who require access to perform their official functions, and externally solely with government agencies such as the Social Security System (SSS), Home Development Mutual Fund (Pag IBIG), and Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth), but only to the extent necessary for the processing of statutory benefits, compliance with mandatory reporting obligations, or as expressly required by applicable laws and regulations. All disclosures are governed by the principles of necessity, proportionality, and lawful purpose under the Data Privacy Act of 2012, ensuring that employee information is released exclusively for legitimate purposes and safeguarded through appropriate contractual, organizational, and technical measures to prevent unauthorized use or disclosure. Whenever personal data is shared with or processed by authorized third-party service providers, cloud vendors, or system administrators managing the HR Service Portal, Primeline guarantees that such transfers are governed by formal Outsourcing or Data Sharing Agreements. These agreements strictly bind the third party to implement identical or more stringent organizational, physical, and technical security measures as required by the Data Privacy Act of 2012.

Data Retention & Security

Primeline retains personal data collected through the HR Service Portal for the duration of your employment and for a period of Three (3) years from your separation from the company to fulfill the specific purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, including the administration of employment, processing of HR related requests, and compliance with statutory obligations, or for such longer period as may be expressly required under applicable laws and regulations. Once the lawful purpose of processing has been achieved, personal data shall be securely deleted, anonymized, or archived in a manner that prevents unauthorized access or further use. Throughout the retention period, Primeline applies a comprehensive framework of administrative, technical, and physical safeguards such as strict access controls, encryption, secure storage systems, and regular compliance reviews to protect employee information against risks of unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction, thereby ensuring confidentiality, integrity, and availability in accordance with the principles of accountability and data minimization under the Data Privacy Act of 2012.

Data Subject Rights

Employees are entitled to exercise their rights as data subjects under the Data Privacy Act of 2012, which include the right to access their personal data, the right to request correction or rectification of any inaccurate or outdated information, the right to request deletion or blocking of data that is no longer necessary or unlawfully processed, and the right to withdraw previously granted consent to processing at any time, subject to applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual limitations. Primeline affirms its commitment to respect and facilitate the exercise of these rights through lawful and transparent procedures, ensuring that requests are addressed promptly and fairly. For any privacy related concerns, clarifications, or formal requests regarding the exercise of these rights, employees may directly contact their designated HR department or the Data Protection Officer, who shall provide appropriate guidance and assistance in accordance with company policy and regulatory requirements.

Terms and Conditions

By accessing and using the Primeline HR Service Portal, you expressly acknowledge and agree to be bound by the terms and conditions set forth herein, which govern the lawful use of the system, the processing of personal data, and the responsibilities of both the company and its employees. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, or if you are unwilling to comply with the obligations imposed herein, you are advised to immediately discontinue use of the portal, as access and utilization are strictly conditioned upon full adherence to this Policy and the governing legal framework.

Acceptable Use

The Primeline HR Service Portal shall be used exclusively for legitimate and authorized human resource–related transactions by duly recognized employees of the company. Any act of misuse, including but not limited to falsification or misrepresentation of information, unauthorized access or attempted access to restricted data, circumvention of security protocols, or utilization of the portal for purposes other than its intended HR functions, constitutes a violation of company policy and may subject the responsible employee to disciplinary measures ranging from administrative sanctions to termination, without prejudice to civil or criminal liability under applicable laws. All users are expected to exercise integrity, confidentiality, and accountability when using the portal, and Primeline reserves the right to monitor, audit, and investigate portal activity to ensure compliance with these acceptable use standards.

Accuracy of Requests

Employees are solely responsible for ensuring that all information submitted through the HR Service Portal—including requests, forms, and letters—is truthful, accurate, current, and complete at the time of submission. Any omission, misrepresentation, or falsification of data may compromise the integrity of HR processes and shall be deemed a violation of company policy. Primeline reserves the right, in the exercise of its legitimate business and compliance functions, to verify the authenticity and accuracy of all submitted information, and may lawfully delay, suspend, or deny the processing of requests found to contain incomplete, erroneous, or misleading details. Such measures are intended to protect both the employee and the company from administrative errors, fraudulent claims, or regulatory breaches, and are implemented in accordance with the principles of accountability and lawful purpose under the Data Privacy Act of 2012.

Data Collection & Consent

By checking the agreement box below and proceeding to access or use the Primeline HR Service Portal, you expressly acknowledge, consent, and agree that Primeline may lawfully collect, process, and store your personal and employment related data, including information submitted through requests, forms, and letters, strictly in accordance with the purposes and limitations set forth in this Privacy Policy. Such processing is undertaken solely to enable the delivery of legitimate HR services, including the administration of employment records, benefits, payroll, and other human resource functions, and is governed by the principles of transparency, proportionality, and accountability under the Data Privacy Act of 2012. Your continued use of the portal signifies your informed consent to these practices, subject to applicable legal and contractual restrictions, and affirms you’re understanding that all data handling activities are safeguarded through appropriate organizational, physical, and technical measures to protect confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

Changes to These Terms

Primeline reserves the right to amend, revise, or update these Terms and Conditions at any time to reflect changes in company policies, operational requirements, regulatory mandates, or applicable laws. Any such modifications shall take effect immediately upon posting within the HR Service Portal, and employees are deemed to have constructive notice of these revisions once published. Your continued access to and use of the portal following the posting of updated terms shall constitute your full acknowledgment and acceptance of the revised provisions, including any new obligations or restrictions imposed therein. If you do not agree with the updated terms, you are advised to discontinue use of the portal, as ongoing utilization signifies your binding consent to be governed by the most current version of these Terms and Conditions.

Governing Law

These Terms and Conditions shall be governed by, and construed strictly in accordance with, the laws of the Republic of the Philippines, including all applicable statutes, regulations, and jurisprudence. The rights and obligations of both Primeline and its employees arising from the use of the HR Service Portal shall be interpreted and enforced under Philippine law, without regard to conflict of law principles that might otherwise apply. Any dispute, claim, or controversy relating to the interpretation, validity, or enforcement of these Terms shall be resolved in accordance with the substantive and procedural laws of the Philippines, subject to the jurisdiction of the appropriate courts or arbitral tribunals therein, unless otherwise expressly provided by agreement or mandated by statute. This governing law provision ensures consistency, predictability, and compliance with the national legal framework, thereby safeguarding both the company and its employees under the rule of law.
